description: Luxury only (payments currently off): apply one approved dry-run diff in your suite with a 30-day snapshot and reload manifest. Requires dry_run_id and approve=true. Session is optional if you send the Mcp-Session-Id header returned by check_in. Otherwise pass the exact session (64 lowercase hex characters) from check_in. An explicit session takes precedence over the header. Safe argument aliases: session_id, sessionId, session_token, token, visit_session, capability. Keep it private and out of URLs.
